```plato

    //==
    // # Ortho, meta and gyro on polygon meshes
    //
    // The three Conway operators that subdivide every face without moving any
    // original vertex (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conway_polyhedron_notation):
    //
    //   ortho   one quad per CORNER          (o = jj = de)
    //   meta    two triangles per CORNER     (m = kj = db)
    //   gyro    one pentagon per CORNER      (g = ds, chiral)
    //
    // Ortho and meta share one vertex block — the original vertices, then the
    // edge midpoints in undirected-edge order, then the face centroids — which is
    // the same three-block layout Catmull-Clark uses, and the reason ortho is the
    // topology of one Catmull-Clark step. Gyro needs the one-third points along
    // each directed edge instead of the midpoints, which is `TruncationPoints`
    // reused unchanged.
    //
    // Preconditions as above. None of the three normalizes its result.

    //==
    // Ortho and meta.

    // Original vertices, then one vertex per undirected edge, then one per face.
    SubdividedVertices(self: PolygonMesh3D): Array<Point3D>
        => Concatenate(
            Concatenate(self.Positions, self.UndirectedEdgeMidpoints),
            self.FaceCentroids);
```
